explanation: Hydrochloric acid reacts with sodium hydroxide in a neutralization reaction to form sodium chloride and water.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A pink solution — sodium hydroxide tinted with a few drops of phenolphthalein indicator.
beaker_view.final_appearance: Colourless, once enough acid has been added to neutralise the base.
beaker_view.observation: Adding the acid drop by drop makes the pink colour fade away to colourless right at the neutralisation point, and adding a little more base afterward brings the pink straight back.
